mapper.sql: SELECT id, file_id, title, audio_url, duration, file_type, file_ext, source_type, narrator, play_count, tags, status, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM audio_item
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.title, a.audio_url, a.duration, a.file_type, a.file_ext, a.source_type, a.play_count, a.tags FROM audio_play_history h JOIN audio_item a ON h.audio_id = a.id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.audio_id) FROM audio_play_history h JOIN audio_item a ON h.audio_id = a.id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audio_item (file_id, title, audio_url, duration, file_type, file_ext, source_type, narrator, tags, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{title}, #{audioUrl}, #{duration}, #{fileType}, #{fileExt}, #{sourceType}, #{narrator}, #{tags, typeHandler=com.xinling.framework.typehandler.JacksonListTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update:
UPDATE audio_item
file_id = #{fileId}, title = #{title}, audio_url = #{audioUrl}, duration = #{duration}, file_type = #{fileType}, file_ext = #{fileExt}, source_type = #{sourceType}, narrator = #{narrator}, tags = #{tags, typeHandler=com.xinling.framework.typehandler.JacksonListTypeHandler}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE audio_item SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE audio_item SET play_count = play_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audio_play_history (user_id, audio_id, played_duration) VALUES (#{userId}, #{audioId}, #{playedDuration})
